Use case: style-transfer. Make one square imaginative rough-painted card illustration for 搜索大宝箱, whose effect is obtaining three random cards.
Input 1 is the NovelAI draft and controls the composition: one floating open battered treasure chest tilted diagonally at lower-left, three blank rectangular cards rising across the right, and the large plum-purple/burnt-orange abstract background division. Input 2 is 惩击 and controls ONLY paint handling: broad opaque matte masses, directional broad strokes, hard-edged grouped light and shadow, selective detail. Do not copy its subject, costume or light beam.
Keep the chest's floating diagonal attitude and open lid, with an exaggerated near corner and compressed receding lid. Its dark interior is an impossible violet opening rather than a realistic empty compartment. Repair the draft's missing motion shape: add ONE broad curling golden-ochre swathe erupting from the chest mouth and sweeping in an upward curve toward the upper-right. It is a bold curved brush shape, not a thin glowing line, not a physical string, not a beam. Arrange EXACTLY THREE blank ivory cards loosely tumbling ALONG this curve, separated by clear background gaps. Remove the connecting knots/strings between the draft's cards. The first card close to the chest is largest, the middle card smaller, and the highest card smallest; keep all three card silhouettes completely visible, including the topmost card. They are single flat rectangles with slight perspective and a few angular shadow planes; no piles, books, text or symbols. Strongest bright-dark contrast belongs to the chest mouth and the nearest escaping card. Keep the overall lower-left to upper-right flow. Dreamlike, playful, slightly impossible geometry is welcome; only the open box, the wide curl and three cards are needed.
Repaint with rough hand-painted anime concept-art economy. Construct wood from a few connected dark brown and plum planes with blunt large swipes, not individual plank grooves or realistic wood grain. Metal bands are quiet dark gray angular masses with one sparse muted highlight; no rivet networks, engraved decorations or polished reflections. Use broad uneven opaque strokes with handmade broken edges and selective overpainting, large calm areas between the strokes. Preserve believable main lid/hinge/opening shapes while allowing expressive tilted perspective. Do not break surfaces into small triangular mosaics. Cards need only clear outlines, broad ivory faces and a single gray-violet underside turn.
Background stays a large quiet combination of plum purple and burnt orange, with restrained broad transitions, painted coarsely in a few color masses. Muted chest colors, concentrated warm gold at its opening, not glitter everywhere. Avoid fine lineart, glossy 3D, airbrush polish plus grain, all-over texture filters, tiny particles, scenery, coins, jewels, extra props. No people, faces, hands or arms. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
